sources_considered.why: OpenAI's primary launch post. It compares GPT-4o directly with GPT-4 and GPT-4 Turbo.
LMSYS leaderboard data file dated 2024-07-23. It holds Arena-Hard-Auto win rates against GPT-4-0314 as the baseline.
Compares GPT-4o with GPT-4 Turbo but has no row for the original GPT-4-0314. The page was also updated long after the post.
The abstract page did not contain the benchmark tables needed.

receipt.public_excerpt: GPT‑4o achieves GPT‑4 Turbo-level performance on text, reasoning, and coding intelligence

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI itself says GPT-4o's text, reasoning and coding level matches the GPT-4 Turbo line. That supports the claim of no significant jump in core intelligence.

receipt.public_excerpt: As a first fruit of this research, we’re able to make a GPT‑4 level model available much more broadly.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI calls GPT-4o a 'GPT-4 level model'. The gain it describes is efficiency and access, not a higher level of capability.

evidence_items.locator: section after the capability video list, paragraph 1

receipt.public_excerpt: Prior to GPT‑4o, you could use Voice Mode⁠ to talk to ChatGPT with latencies of 2.8 seconds (GPT‑3.5) and 5.4 seconds (GPT‑4) on average.

evidence_items.explanation: Elsewhere the same page says GPT-4o answers audio in about 320 ms on average, through a single end-to-end model. That cuts GPT-4's 5.4 s voice latency sharply and adds native audio and vision. These are substantial differences beyond text.

In the same file, GPT-4-0314 is the Arena-Hard-Auto baseline at 50.0. GPT-4o scores 79.21, meaning it was judged better than the original March 2023 GPT-4 on most hard prompts. The file also lists MMLU at 0.887 versus 0.864 for GPT-4-0314.

unresolved_gaps: 'Significantly' has no threshold, so whether a 79% judged win rate or a modest MMLU gain counts as significant is a judgment call.
Arena-Hard-Auto uses a GPT-4-class model as judge, which may favour OpenAI models.
The publication date of the LMSYS CSV is taken from its own date column (2024-07-23), not from a separate timestamp.
